title: Literal product selector pair law
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite set, let $π$ be a probability mass function on $Ω$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $θ\in[-1,1]$. The literal product selector coordinate law, transported by the coordinate-pair equivalence, is a probability mass function on $(Ω^n)\times(Ω^n)$.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the literal product selector coordinate law and the coordinate-pair equivalence.
